dossier_meta.paper: On the Hat Guessing Number of Graphs
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Belief on Degeneracy Bound for Hat Guessing Number
dossier_meta.statement_text: It seems plausible that there exists a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $d$-degenerate graph $G$, $\mathrm{HG}(G) \leq f(d)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors remark in the open problems section that such a bounding function seems plausible, noting that it would imply absolute constant bounds on the hat guessing number of planar graphs (which are $5$-degenerate) and a Hadwiger-number bound via degeneracy results.
